The #3a90ae Rampa reports is the darkest pixel of the anti-aliased thin glyphs in the screenshot (the 'Início' link, with the same CSS colour, also never renders darker than #1687b7), so the stated 3.63:1 is not the text's contrast: claimTrue no. Understanding 1.4.3 says to use the colours from the user agent or the style sheets 'rather than the text as presented on screen', because anti-aliasing makes thin fonts look fainter. The live HTML and CSS fetched on 2026-11-25 match the capture (same markup, same stylesheet colours, styled screenshot), so captureDiffers no.
